title: Arkret Applet Managed Device Authentication
description: base64url_no_pad(JCS) metadata for an accepted Realm Bot/Ghost Device HTTP signature. Exact full actor, current generation, Device bounds and current installation are checked at the owning Realm current governor; no AccountId or SessionGrant is inferred.

nonce.description: Independent random request nonce with at least 128 bits of entropy, signed inside the closed metadata.
